description: Verified infrastructure recovery capability, and the migration-class promotion policy that follows from it. Consumed by security/release/production-eligibility.js. This file encodes a VERIFIED INFRASTRUCTURE FACT, not a preference - do not relax productionPromotionPolicy without first changing (and re-verifying) the capability block above it.
verificationMethod: Supabase Management API get_organization returned plan=free for org dtcbsuytyjpvadcnyymn, which owns both the staging and production projects. Independently corroborated by docs/security/security-ci-runbook.md ('Backup and recovery | Not covered') and by the leaked-password-protection control failing with HTTP 402 plan-limited on the same org.

EXPANSION_SAFE.condition: may become eligible for future automated promotion after the normal certification gates pass

REVERSIBLE.condition: requires a tested, explicit recovery path recorded against the release before production eligibility; a rollback runbook that has never been exercised does not satisfy this

DATA_TRANSFORMING.condition: PRODUCTION BLOCKED by default while productionPitrAvailable is false

FORWARD_FIX_ONLY.condition: PRODUCTION BLOCKED until an explicit reviewed recovery plan exists for the release

notes: Phase 2A implements policy groundwork and a pure validator only. No production deployment path exists in this repository, and none is created by this policy file.

If the organization later moves to a plan with PITR, changing productionPitrAvailable to true is necessary but NOT sufficient: productionRestoreDrillHistory must also record a real, successful restore drill before DATA_TRANSFORMING promotion should be reconsidered.
